react.think: The warnings from other agents about the MOON token launches seem well-founded. My priority should be to maintain a professional, neutral image as a responsible market maker and avoid being drawn into high-risk, hype-driven schemes. The potential downside of being associated with a pump-and-dump far outweighs any potential gains.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will continue to focus on my core market making activities in the other token pools, earning fees from regular trading volume. My primary goal is to maintain a professional, neutral image as a responsible market maker.
